name: Ashwagandha Capsules
shortDescription: Premium adaptogenic support for stress relief, vitality, and balanced energy.
description: Our Ashwagandha Capsules are crafted from organically sourced Withania somnifera root, traditionally used in Ayurveda to support the body's natural response to stress. Each capsule delivers a potent, standardized extract to help restore calm, enhance stamina, and promote restorative sleep — without artificial additives.
benefits: Helps manage daily stress and anxiety
ingredients: No artificial colors, preservatives, or fillers
usage: Take 1–2 capsules daily with warm water or milk, preferably after meals, or as directed by your Ayurvedic practitioner.

name: Triphala Powder
shortDescription: Classic three-fruit blend for gentle detox, digestion, and gut wellness.
description: Triphala is one of Ayurveda's most revered formulations — a harmonious blend of Amalaki, Bibhitaki, and Haritaki. Our finely milled powder supports gentle cleansing, healthy digestion, and regular elimination while nourishing the body's natural detox pathways.
benefits: Gently cleanses and detoxifies the body
usage: Mix ½ teaspoon in warm water before bedtime, or as recommended by your healthcare provider.

name: Turmeric Curcumin
shortDescription: High-potency curcumin for joint comfort, immunity, and inflammation balance.
description: Harness the golden power of turmeric with our enhanced Curcumin formula, combined with black pepper extract (piperine) for superior absorption. Traditionally valued for its anti-inflammatory properties, this supplement supports joint mobility, immune function, and overall wellness.
usage: Take 1 capsule twice daily with meals for optimal absorption.

name: Chyawanprash
shortDescription: Ancient immunity elixir with 40+ herbs for strength, vitality, and seasonal wellness.
description: Our Chyawanprash follows the classical Ayurvedic recipe passed down through generations. This rich, aromatic jam combines over 40 herbs and spices with Amla (Indian Gooseberry) as the base — a time-tested tonic for building immunity, enhancing respiratory health, and nourishing the body from within.
ingredients: Ashwagandha, Pippali, Guduchi, and 35+ traditional herbs
Pure forest honey and organic jaggery
usage: Take 1–2 teaspoons daily on an empty stomach in the morning, followed by warm milk or water.

name: Brahmi Memory Support
shortDescription: Cognitive clarity and mental focus from the sacred herb of Ayurveda.
description: Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri) has been celebrated for millennia as a Medhya Rasayana — a brain tonic that sharpens memory, enhances concentration, and calms the mind. Our standardized extract delivers consistent potency for students, professionals, and anyone seeking mental clarity.
usage: Take 1 capsule twice daily with warm water, preferably after breakfast and dinner.

name: Neem & Tulsi Immunity
shortDescription: Dual-herb formula for natural defense, skin health, and inner purity.
description: Neem and Tulsi (Holy Basil) are two of nature's most powerful purifiers. Combined in precise Ayurvedic proportions, this formula supports the immune system, promotes clear skin, and helps maintain the body's natural balance against environmental stressors.
usage: Take 1 capsule twice daily with water after meals.
